title: Step 4: Play the Game
story: The temple door is locked. Only someone carrying the key can enter. Time to run a whole game from a list of commands.
goal: Add run(commands): start in "hut" with an empty bag. "go <direction>" moves, "take" picks up, anything else is ignored. The temple needs the key to enter. Return (room, bag).
hints: Keep two variables, room and bag, and loop over the commands.
For "go x", cmd[3:] is the direction. Block the move if it would enter the temple without the key.
socratic: Which earlier functions can run() reuse?
What if the player walks into the locked door?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: how does this checkpoint build on the last one?
